definitions.explanation: Efforts to revive or energize a town or local community, typically through tourism promotion, local product development, events, or other economic and cultural initiatives. A major topic in Japanese regional policy.

examples.japanese: {町|まち}おこし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I participated in a town revitalization event.

examples.japanese: ゆる⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{町|まち}おこし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になった。
examples.english: Town revitalization using mascot characters became a hot topic nationwide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧{町|まち}おこし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧、⟦{廃校|はいこう}→廃校：12548_haikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}び{込|こ}んでいる→呼び込む：06087_yobikomu⟧。
examples.english: Young people are taking the lead in town revitalization, converting a closed school into a café to attract tourists.

notes:
USAGE:
{町|まち}おこし is a key concept in Japanese regional policy, referring to grassroots or government-supported efforts to revive declining rural towns and small cities. It can also be written as {町興|まちおこ}し. The related term ⟦{村|むら}おこし→村おこし：21175_muraokoshi⟧ is used specifically for village revitalization.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {町|まち}おこし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧ (work on town revitalization)
- {町|まち}おこし⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧ (revitalization event)
- {町|まち}おこし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一環|いっかん}→一環：17696_ikkan⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (as part of town revitalization)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{活性化|かっせいか}→活性化：07563_kasseika⟧: regional revitalization (more formal, policy-oriented)
- ⟦{地方|ちほう}{創生|そうせい}→地方創生：20989_chihousousei⟧: regional creation/revitalization (government policy term coined in 2014)
- ⟦{村|むら}おこし→村おこし：21175_muraokoshi⟧: village revitalization (same concept for villages)
